which_endpoint: EFS by IRF (stage IIB-IIIB, EGFR/ALK wild-type)
search_notes: CORRECTED 2026-10-08 after a second check: Roche's FY2025 pipeline document (status as of 2026-01-29) states 'Study did not meet primary endpoint Q4 2025' for IMpower030 and lists it as removed from phase III; that is the first disclosure. The conference presentation of 2026-09-12 was the first data, not the first disclosure. Earlier note: IMpower030 final analysis, WCLC 2026 oral OA04.03 (Seoul, 12 Sep 2026): median EFS 62.8 vs 34.9 mo, not statistically significant; OncLive, News-Medical and ASCO Post coverage opened, none gives the HR. HR 0.77 (0.58-1.02), p=0.07 was seen ONLY in a search summary of a paywalled Cancer Therapy Advisor report (HTTP 402, not opened). No Roche release found; trial is in the Roche HY2025 pipeline PDF with no result and absent from the HY2026 one, so a silent pipeline removal may predate WCLC.

which_endpoint: PFS not reported; ALC change (second registry primary) reported as significant
search_notes: QUILT-2.023 (N-803/Anktiva): ImmunityBio release of 13 Jan 2026 (company page ir.immunitybio.com/node/11041 timed out; opened a reposted copy) says the primary endpoint was PFS, enrolment closed early (102 enrolled per registry) and lymphocyte count rose significantly (p=0.0065 per search summary of the Business Wire text), but gives no PFS result. Registry: Terminated, no results posted; ApexOnco noted the PFS omission.

which_endpoint: OS
search_notes: EPCORE DLBCL-1: Genmab / AbbVie topline of 16 Jan 2026 (AbbVie copy and a MarketScreener copy of the Genmab announcement opened): OS not significant, PFS improved (HR 0.74, 0.60-0.92). OS is the registry primary and sole US primary; PFS and OS were dual primaries outside the US (OncLive 24 Jul 2026). Full data at EHA 2026 (S235, 12 Jun 2026).

China sub-study of GCT3013-05 (72 patients, registered separately in 2025). Searched NCT, GCT3013-05 sub-study, epcoritamab China, Genmab and AbbVie releases: the 16 Jan 2026 topline and EHA 2026 data describe only the 483-patient global trial and no China-specific OS result was found. Registry: active, not recruiting, no results.

which_endpoint: OS
search_notes: ONO-4538-113 is ATTRACTION-6 (acronym not in registry). ASCO 2026 abstract 4006 read via the Crossref record of the DOI (deposited 27 May 2026; ascopubs page returns 403): OS not met, median 15.7 vs 15.8 mo; the interval is a 95.8% CI. ASCO probably released the abstract about a week earlier; oral presentation 1 Jun 2026 (OncoDaily coverage opened). No Ono topline release found, only the 22 Apr 2026 programme notice.

which_endpoint: OS
search_notes: BURAN: Adlai Nortye topline release (6-K of 30 May 2025) says OS primary not met, no numbers, buparlisib discontinued; this is five months before the registry primary completion date. HR first shown at ESMO 2025 (LBA48); earliest coverage opened is dated 20 Oct 2025 and the session day within 17-21 Oct is not confirmed.

which_endpoint: OS and ORR by IRRC (co-primary)
search_notes: CIBI310C301: ASCO 2026 poster abstract 4148 read via the Crossref record of the DOI (deposited 27 May 2026; poster 30 May). Median OS 44.0 mo (3 mg/kg cohort) and 36.1 mo (1 mg/kg cohort) vs 22.9 mo sorafenib, ORR 41.7% / 22.1% vs 2.6% called significantly higher, but no HR, no p-value and no statement that the primary endpoint was met; IBI310 dose was changed mid-trial. Innovent 2026 interim results (HKEX, 25 Aug 2026) only cite the abstract; no topline notice found.

which_endpoint: EFS by investigator (stage II-IIIA)
search_notes: LIBRETTO-432: Lilly topline release of 16 Feb 2026 (investor.lilly.com/node/53881 blocked; opened same-day Cure Today coverage and Targeted Oncology, which dates the release 16 Feb): EFS met, no numbers. HR from the NEJM paper published online 31 May 2026 with the ASCO 2026 plenary (LBA3); ASCO coverage (search summary) quotes 0.172 (0.058-0.509).

which_endpoint: PFS (dual primary with OS; OS not tested at this interim)
search_notes: KEYNOTE-204: Merck release of 2 Mar 2020 said PFS was met at an interim analysis, no numbers; HR in the Merck release of 13 May 2020 for ASCO 2020 (abstract 8005). The registry primary completion date (Jan 2026) reflects final OS follow-up, hence a lag of nearly -6 years; no final OS disclosure was traced.

which_endpoint: EFS (dual primary with OS; population described only as "certain patients")
search_notes: KEYNOTE-975: no stand-alone release found; the result is one sentence in the Merck Q1 2026 results release of 30 Apr 2026 (EFS not statistically significant). Not in the Q4 2025 release (3 Feb 2026) or the Q2 2026 release; the 10-K and 10-Q were not checked, and no HR, abstract or paper was found.

which_endpoint: PFS by investigator
search_notes: BO41843 is persevERA (acronym not in registry). Roche ad hoc announcement of 9 Mar 2026: PFS primary not met, numerical improvement, no numbers. HR at ASCO 2026 (LBA1006), p=0.1553; coverage opened is dated 2 Jun 2026 and the session day is not confirmed.

which_endpoint: PFS by BICR and OS (dual primary; both experimental arms)
search_notes: MK-6482-012 is LITESPARK-012 (acronym not in registry). Merck / Eisai release of 21 Apr 2026: at a pre-specified interim analysis neither the belzutifan triplet nor the quavonlimab arm met the dual primary endpoints; no numbers, futility not stated. No HR found; data said to be planned for a later congress.

CA017-078 is ENERGIZE (acronym not in registry). Searched NCT, CA017-078, ENERGIZE, linrodostat / BMS-986205 and BMS Q2 2026 materials (30 Jul 2026, no mention): nothing found. Scheduled as ESMO 2026 proffered paper 4736O (23-27 Oct 2026, nivolumab vs chemotherapy comparison) per an OncoDaily preview of 7 Oct 2026 that states no outcome.

which_endpoint: PFS by BICR (Part 2, elranatamab vs DPd; interim analysis)
search_notes: MagnetisMM-5: Pfizer release of 29 Apr 2026 (pfizer.com returns 403; opened same-day Targeted Oncology coverage): PFS met at a pre-specified interim analysis, "exceeded the target hazard ratio", no numbers. No HR found at ASCO or EHA 2026; registry still says recruiting.

which_endpoint: PFS (high-dose fianlimab + cemiplimab vs pembrolizumab)
search_notes: R3767-ONC-2011: Regeneron release (investor.regeneron.com blocked; opened a reposted copy dated 15 May 2026): PFS not significant, p=0.0627, median 11.5 vs 6.4 mo; low dose HR 0.931. Date conflict: MarketScreener copy is stamped 16 May and Targeted Oncology cites 17 May; no May 2026 8-K seen on EDGAR.

which_endpoint: PFS by IRC (Tec-Tal vs EPd/PVd; Tal-P also met)
search_notes: MonumenTAL-6: J&J release of 23 Jul 2026; IDMC recommended unblinding at the first interim analysis. HR cells are teclistamab + talquetamab; talquetamab + pomalidomide HR 0.27 (0.20-0.35). The trial continues, so recorded as met rather than stopped_efficacy.

ARO-021: searched NCT, ARO-021, crenolanib vs midostaurin and Arog (private, no news page found) across ASCO, EHA and ASH: no result. Registry completed 6 Apr 2026 with 214 of about 510 planned patients, no results posted; the only Arog phase 3 data found (ASH 2025) are from the separate relapsed/refractory trial NCT03250338.

MAGNOLIA (abelacimab): registry Terminated, "Sponsor Decision", 417 enrolled (EU CTIS lists 1,033 planned, per search summary), no results. Per a Fierce Biotech article of 22 Apr 2026 (403, read in search summary only) Novartis stopped MAGNOLIA alongside ASTER after ASTER looked set to fail against apixaban; no result for MAGNOLIA itself was reported and no Novartis release was found.

KEYNOTE-B49: not mentioned in the Merck Q4 2025, Q1 2026 or Q2 2026 results releases, and no topline release found. Listed as ESMO 2026 late-breaking abstract LBA51 (23-27 Oct 2026) in an OncoDaily preview of 28 Sep 2026 that states no outcome.

AIPAC-003 (eftilagimod alfa): only the 66-patient randomised phase 2 dose-optimisation part ran; the placebo-controlled phase 3 part with the OS primary never started. Immutep ASX quarterly of 30 Apr 2026 still described phase 2 follow-up; registry later changed to Terminated, "Sponsor Decision" (updated 30 Jul 2026), after the sibling TACTI-004 futility stop of Mar 2026. No termination announcement found.

which_endpoint: RFS (durvalumab + bevacizumab vs placebo)
search_notes: EMERALD-2: no stand-alone release found; first appears as a "new disclosure" in the AstraZeneca H1/Q2 2026 results announcement of 27 Jul 2026 (readout dated Q2 2026): did not meet the primary endpoint of RFS vs placebo. No HR public.

which_endpoint: PFS by BICR
search_notes: Krascendo 1: Roche ad hoc announcement of 2 Jul 2026 (Genentech version dated 1 Jul US time): divarasib met PFS and the key secondary OS at interim versus sotorasib or adagrasib; no numbers. No HR found at WCLC 2026 or elsewhere.

which_endpoint: OS in 3L+ (dual primary; PFS by BICR in all randomised not met)
search_notes: D9802C00001 is CLARITY-Gastric01, AZD0901 is sonesitatug vedotin (neither name in registry). AstraZeneca release of 27 Jul 2026, same day as the H1 results (both opened): OS dual primary met, PFS dual primary showed a trend but was not significant; AstraZeneca tabulates it as "primary endpoint met". No numbers yet.

which_endpoint: OS in ITT (dual primary; OS in non-liver-metastases later not met)
search_notes: STELLAR-303 (XL092 is zanzalintinib): Exelixis release of 22 Jun 2025 (ir.exelixis.com blocked; opened a reposted copy dated 22 Jun; BioSpace copy is stamped 23 Jun): ITT OS met at final analysis, no numbers. HR at ESMO 2025 (LBA30) and in the Lancet, coverage opened dated 20 Oct 2025. The other dual primary missed on 22 Jun 2026 (HR 0.83, 0.66-1.05, search summary only), which is what the registry primary completion date tracks.

which_endpoint: OS
search_notes: CheckMate 9DW: BMS release of 20 Mar 2024 (news.bms.com blocked; opened BioSpace and another reposted copy, both dated 20 Mar): OS met at a pre-specified interim analysis, no numbers. HR in the BMS release of 4 Jun 2024 for ASCO 2024 (LBA4008). Registry primary completion date (Jul 2026) is 28 months after the readout.

which_endpoint: PFS by investigator (tiragolumab + atezolizumab vs placebo; first in the testing hierarchy)
search_notes: SKYSCRAPER-07: no Roche release. ApexOnco article of 24 Apr 2025 (opening lines opened, rest paywalled) says the failure was slipped into the Roche Q1 2025 results presentation; a Roche spokesperson confirming the missed primary is from a search summary of the same article, and the Roche slide itself was not opened. HR at ESMO 2025 (17 Oct per ApexOnco; article opened is dated 20 Oct, no CI); CI 0.65-1.03, p=0.0947 from the Annals of Oncology paper (PMID 42628839, 21 Aug 2026) as summarised by OncoDaily.

DYNASTY-Breast02 (DB-1303 / BNT323 is trastuzumab pamirtecan): not read out. BioNTech Q2 2026 release (6-K, 4 Aug 2026) says the primary analysis is expected in Q4 2026; the Sep 2025 "met PFS" release belongs to the sibling China HER2-positive trial NCT06265428.

VERSATILE-003: PDS Biotech ended company funding on 11 Aug 2026 to prioritise PDS0301 (OncLive coverage opened); registry Terminated for "financial constraints" with 12 patients enrolled, so no OS or PFS analysis is possible.

KontRASt-02 (JDQ443 is opnurasib): Novartis discontinued opnurasib in its Q2 2024 update for portfolio reasons (ApexOnco, 18 Jul 2024, opening lines opened; "not driven by clinical data" is from search summaries). Enrolment ended at 95 of about 360 planned; registry still active, not recruiting, with no results, and no PFS analysis, abstract or paper was found.
